NoSQLServer v0.75 validation
============================

Runtime
-------
ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 (64-bit, build 3 August 2026), from the user-supplied Debian package.

Optional Unicode provider
-------------------------
User-supplied TUTOR 0.7 tree.

TUTOR remains external and optional; it is not redistributed by NoSQLServer.

Unicode design boundary
-----------------------
Default: CLASSIC.
Opt-in: table/column textMode UNICODE plus explicit TUTOR enable.

UNICODE:
  strict UTF-8
  TUTOR Text / NFC
  Extended Grapheme Cluster text functions
  canonical-equivalent equality and constraints

Not claimed:
  locale-aware collation
  implicit Unicode
  legacy encoding conversion
  TUTOR as a mandatory dependency
